search_window.basis: Since independently verified prior Food Line Source Watch heartbeat, with 1-2 day search recency to allow indexing lag; qualification requires newly reported or materially substantiated immediate access disruption within observation window, not merely a fresh crawl.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary bounded high-value recall only; primary nationwide Food Line collection remains authoritative.
target_classes: Only, sole, last or community full-service grocery lost to closure, fire or disaster
Emergency food distribution canceled or suspended due to storm, flood, fire, power outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry or food bank service closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP, WIC or food-assistance interruption with immediate access effects
bounded_query_context: "only grocery store" closed fire November 2 2026 community
"sole grocery store" OR "last grocery store" fire closure 2026 November 2
"only supermarket" shut down fire town November 2 2026
"full service grocery store" closure community November 2 2026
"food pantry" closed flooding power outage November 2 2026
"food bank" suspended services storm damage November 2 2026
coverage_notes.observation: Twelve targeted searches were executed. No corroborated new qualifying U.S. disruption emerged after the 16:42:23 PST prior heartbeat. Returned matches primarily described older sole-grocery losses, historical fire/storm events, routine grocery policy or proposed incentives, a 2026-11-01 SNAP food-category eligibility rule rather than an issuance/access outage, and 2025 SNAP shutdown notices.

excluded_examples.reason: Spencer, NY only-store fire is from September 2026, not a new hourly event.
Eastport, Maine sole-grocery closure previously announced in August; duplicate historical case.
Four-day-old recovery/resource guidance, no verified canceled distribution newly reported in window.
November 1, 2026 soda purchase eligibility change; the agency says benefit amount is unchanged; not an outage or distribution failure.
Proposed grocery tax incentives to expand access; no newly lost grocery access.
Prior-year November SNAP shutdown context, not a new 2026 interruption.

duplicate_screen.method: Read previous heartbeat directly from ops/watch-ledger and screened results for prior-known cases and report/event-date mismatches.

coverage_notes.limitations: A bounded 12-query web recall is not comprehensive; very recent local provider notices may be unindexed or undiscoverable; no new qualifying signal was independently verified.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approvals, publication, modifications of primary collection, schedule changes or task disabling.
